entry.title: Decision Records
entry.summary: The immutable log of architectural decisions for the example.
entry.content:
ADRs are never edited once accepted — a new ADR supersedes an old one.

This page is a kind: Hub index: the ADRs below are listed automatically by the Hub layout on build, so there is no hand-maintained table to keep in sync.

To add one, copy template.md from this folder to NNNN-short-title.md. The template is a draft page, so it is only built when drafts are published.
